_note: Common scam types written in my own words. Verify against official sources (PDRM, BNM, MCMC, NSRC).

types.name: Macau scam (fake authority)
signs: Caller claims to be police, court or bank officer
Says you are linked to a crime
Asks you to transfer money to a 'safe account'
types.what_to_do: Hang up. Real authorities never ask for transfers. Call the organisation using its official number.

types.name: Parcel / delivery scam
signs: Unexpected parcel notice
Small fee to be paid via a link
Unofficial tracking website
types.what_to_do: Check tracking in the courier's official app or website that you typed yourself.

types.name: Bank phishing SMS / email
signs: Account locked or suspicious activity warning
Link to a look-alike login page
Asks for username, password or TAC
types.what_to_do: Do not click. Open your bank's official app directly or call the number on your card.

types.name: Love / romance scam
signs: Fast emotional bond with an online stranger
Never meets in person or on video
Eventually asks for money
types.what_to_do: Stop sending money. Talk to someone you trust and report it.

types.name: Fake job / task scam
signs: High pay for simple tasks
Asked to pay a deposit or top up to continue
Contact only via messaging apps
types.what_to_do: Legitimate employers do not ask you to pay to work. Do not deposit money.

types.name: Investment scam
signs: Guaranteed or very high returns
Pressure to invest quickly
Unlicensed platform
types.what_to_do: Check whether the company is licensed by the relevant regulator before investing.

types.name: Fake tax refund (LHDN)
signs: Unexpected refund notice
Link asks for bank login or card details
types.what_to_do: Use the official tax portal by typing the address yourself, or call the official line.

types.name: Utility bill cut-off scam
signs: Threat to cut supply today
Payment through an unofficial link or personal account
types.what_to_do: Check your bill in the provider's official app or website.

types.name: E-wallet verification scam
signs: Wallet 'limit upgrade' or 'verification' message
Link outside the official app
types.what_to_do: Manage the wallet only inside the official app.
